techniques.name: Explicit preference elicitation
techniques.goal: Learn important user preferences without inferring them from noisy behavior
techniques.mechanism: Ask a small targeted question when preference uncertainty materially changes a decision, then store the answer with context/scope.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Expected-future-utility gate decides which unknown is worth asking.
avoid_when: Preference can be inferred cheaply from strong repeated evidence
Question interruption cost exceeds decision impact

techniques.name: Implicit feedback learning
techniques.goal: Learn preferences from choices/interactions when explicit ratings are sparse
techniques.mechanism: Use views, saves, purchases, dismissals, retries, corrections and accepted suggestions as evidence with action-specific weight.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Preserve event type/context; never collapse 'viewed' into 'liked'.
avoid_when: Action has ambiguous motive or exposure bias is severe
risks: Observed behavior is not pure preference

techniques.name: Heterogeneous implicit-feedback weighting
techniques.goal: Avoid treating different user actions as equivalent evidence
techniques.mechanism: Model signals such as view/save/buy/dismiss/repeat separately or learn their relation to target outcome.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS event ontology should retain semantics rather than one generic engagement score.
avoid_when: Very sparse data
risks: Learned weights can reflect UI exposure rather than value

techniques.name: Pairwise preference learning
techniques.goal: Learn relative choices more naturally than absolute ratings
techniques.mechanism: Train/fit ranking so selected/preferred item outranks observed alternatives or explicitly compared items.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use only when exposure set is known or negatives are carefully sampled.
avoid_when: Non-choice doesn't imply rejection because item may not have been seen

techniques.name: Contextual preference model
techniques.goal: Represent that preference changes by task/domain/time/role
techniques.mechanism: Condition recommendation on context such as work vs personal, budget, project, device, company, current goal, urgency and recent intent.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Matches existing separate style profiles and domain boundaries.
avoid_when: Context unavailable/unreliable

techniques.name: Time-decayed preference evidence
techniques.goal: Adapt to changing tastes without erasing history
techniques.mechanism: Reduce default influence of old preference observations while retaining them as historical evidence; reinforce if repeated.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Separate recency from confidence/explicitness; never simply delete historical evidence.
avoid_when: Stable explicit rule/policy
risks: Recent anomaly can outweigh long-term preference

techniques.name: Preference-change / concept-drift detection
techniques.goal: Recognize when old personalization no longer predicts current choices
techniques.mechanism: Monitor correction/dismissal/choice distributions by context and create candidate preference update when regime shifts.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Staged candidate/supersession rather than silent profile rewrite.
avoid_when: Too few observations
risks: Temporary mood mistaken for durable change

techniques.name: Content-based recommendation
techniques.goal: Recommend items similar in meaningful attributes to things the user values
techniques.mechanism: Represent item attributes/text/embeddings and user preference vector/profile; rank by feature compatibility.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use explainable attributes/provenance where possible.
avoid_when: Need surprising discovery outside known taste

techniques.name: Collaborative filtering
techniques.goal: Discover preferences from patterns among similar users/items beyond explicit metadata
techniques.mechanism: Learn latent interaction patterns from a population's ratings/implicit feedback.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Usually less applicable to purely personal local data unless using public community signals.
avoid_when: Single-user local Agent OS without a privacy-safe population dataset

techniques.name: Hybrid content+collaborative recommendation
techniques.goal: Combine personal attribute fit with population discovery
techniques.mechanism: Fuse content, interaction and contextual signals so one method compensates for another's cold-start/overspecialization.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Keep user-specific evidence distinct from community popularity.
avoid_when: No trustworthy collaborative signal

techniques.name: Cold-start use of side information
techniques.goal: Rank new/unseen items before interaction history exists
techniques.mechanism: Use metadata, text, image/audio features, creator/category/price/specs and relationships to infer fit.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Knowledge Engine can supply structured item/entity features.
avoid_when: Side information itself unreliable

techniques.name: Diversity-aware reranking
techniques.goal: Avoid a top list containing near-duplicates of the same idea
techniques.mechanism: After relevance scoring, rerank selected set to trade relevance for pairwise/category/creator/approach diversity.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful for 'what haven't I considered?' and research-radar outputs.
avoid_when: User asks for one exact best match

techniques.name: Novelty-aware recommendation
techniques.goal: Surface relevant things the user likely has not already encountered
techniques.mechanism: Penalize known/seen items and measure exposure/familiarity separately from relevance.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS browser/message history can prevent recommending already-seen items when privacy permits.
avoid_when: Repetition is valuable reminder/reinforcement

techniques.name: Serendipity-aware recommendation
techniques.goal: Surface useful unexpected options outside obvious preference neighborhood
techniques.mechanism: Optimize for relevance/usefulness plus unexpectedness relative to user's normal recommendations/history.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Challenge engine can deliberately reserve a small slot for high-value non-obvious alternatives.
avoid_when: Task demands exact familiar workflow
risks: Unexpectedness is subjective and hard to measure

techniques.name: Coverage-aware recommendation
techniques.goal: Avoid systematically ignoring long-tail parts of the candidate space
techniques.mechanism: Measure which categories/items/sources ever receive exposure and correct unjustified blind spots.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Coverage is a diagnostic/guardrail, not a mandate to show everything.
avoid_when: Candidate space includes lots of known junk

techniques.name: Fairness-aware recommendation
techniques.goal: Detect/limit systematic recommendation disadvantage that is not justified by task goals
techniques.mechanism: Measure outcome/exposure differences for relevant groups/providers and incorporate fairness constraints appropriate to domain.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Do not infer sensitive attributes just to optimize a fairness metric; domain policy controls applicability.
use_when: Domains where fairness is materially relevant and lawful/appropriate
avoid_when: Personal preferences where protected-trait inference is unnecessary or disallowed

techniques.name: Explore/exploit recommendation mix
techniques.goal: Learn new preferences without making the whole experience experimental
techniques.mechanism: Reserve bounded safe fraction for novel/uncertain candidates while most recommendations exploit high-confidence preferences.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Explicit exploration budget; user can request 'safe/familiar' vs 'surprise me'.
avoid_when: High-consequence recommendation

techniques.name: Multi-objective recommendation
techniques.goal: Optimize user value across relevance, price, risk, diversity, novelty, effort, time and constraints rather than one score
techniques.mechanism: Use constrained/weighted/Pareto ranking where hard constraints filter first and soft objectives trade off afterward.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Hard policy/budget constraints never become tradeable score terms.

techniques.name: Pareto-front recommendation
techniques.goal: Show meaningful tradeoff alternatives instead of hiding values in one arbitrary weighted score
techniques.mechanism: Identify non-dominated options across important objectives, then explain the tradeoffs/user can choose.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Keep set small by removing practically indistinguishable options.
avoid_when: One option dominates all meaningful objectives
risks: Too many Pareto options overwhelm user

techniques.name: Constraint-first recommendation
techniques.goal: Never let an attractive score violate hard requirements
techniques.mechanism: Filter candidates against must-have compatibility, privacy, budget, legality, authorization, deadline or technical constraints before personalization/ranking.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Same principle as model routing: eligibility before optimization.

techniques.name: Explanation from actual recommendation evidence
techniques.goal: Help user understand why an item surfaced without fabricating post-hoc reasons
techniques.mechanism: Generate explanation from recorded features/evidence/rules that contributed to retrieval/rank and explicitly label exploratory/serendipitous choices.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Explain observable factors, not hidden chain-of-thought.
avoid_when: Ranker is opaque and no reliable attribution exists

techniques.name: Negative-feedback suppression with changed-evidence escape hatch
techniques.goal: Stop repeating rejected suggestions while allowing meaningful reconsideration
techniques.mechanism: Store dismiss/reject reason and suppress close duplicates until item/context/evidence materially changes or explicit recurrence requires resurfacing.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Re-surface message must explain what changed.

techniques.name: Exposure-aware learning
techniques.goal: Avoid treating unseen items as disliked
techniques.mechanism: Track what the user was actually shown/able to choose among before learning positive/negative preferences.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: No click on an unseen item is no evidence; no click on shown item is still weak/contextual evidence.

techniques.name: Debias popularity feedback loops
techniques.goal: Prevent early popularity/exposure from permanently crowding out equally useful alternatives
techniques.mechanism: Measure popularity/exposure as a confounder, apply diversity/long-tail exploration or propensity-aware evaluation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Research Radar should not equate GitHub stars/mentions with expected Agent OS value.
avoid_when: Pure personal catalog with no population exposure loop

techniques.name: Offline+online recommendation evaluation
techniques.goal: Avoid trusting offline ranking metrics as final user-value evidence
techniques.mechanism: Use offline replay for candidate screening, then shadow/low-risk live feedback or explicit human evaluation to confirm value.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use protected exploration budget and domain-specific guardrails.
avoid_when: No live interaction is ethically/practically acceptable
risks: Online feedback is itself biased by presentation/exposure
